rationale: The stock is trading at the extreme top of its daily range (95.9%) and is consolidating just above the 9-EMA, indicating that the initial gap-down reversal has already played out and momentum is stalling. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of fresh volume to drive a continuation, while shorting into a strong uptrend against a positive earnings surprise is counter-trend.
